description:
News about one person - player, coach, executive or journalist - from gol24.uz, newest first. Use it instead of search_news whenever the question names a specific person. For a club use club_news.
Names on the site are written in Uzbek Latin ("Lamin Yamal", "Kilian Mbappe", "Xansi Flik"); English spellings are matched automatically ("Lamine Yamal" works). Pass the full name: a surname alone is usually not enough.
Returns the matched name and up to `limit` items (default 10, max 20) with the same fields as latest_news. If nobody matches, returns an error - then try search_news with the surname. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute.

person.description: Full name of the person in any common spelling, e.g. "Lamine Yamal" or "Lamin Yamal", "Hansi Flick" or "Xansi Flik".

name: person_news
title: Person News
